decider: agent (Claude, in the Claude Code session)
protocol: step 1 analysis/r03_quant.md (automatic, A3 segment probe) -> step 2 analysis/r03_llm.md (sheets + full-resolution close-ups 0-131 + floor contacts) -> step 3 this file -> train
based_on: r03 model_2998: whole cartwheel from frame 0, lands upright and holds 2 s + 5 s quietly; but goes over on HEAD + FOREARMS (elbows bent before touch-down, body ~0.2 m below the reference) instead of straight arms
priorities: P1 support on straight arms, head / forearms / shoulders off the floor: termination term_below_reference (margin 0.12 m)
keep: the learned chain, landing and the quiet hold (warm start r03 model_2998)
later: robustness (dr 0.75, delay 20 ms 0.65, kp x0.85 0.66 vs gate 0.95), left foot lifted in the first stand, lateral offset in support
code_changes: rl/mimic_generic.term_below_reference (new, generic termination from the reference's own per-body minimum height); re-exported by flip_rewards so terms.* can switch it on
rl/flip_auto/closeup.sh (full-resolution frame tiles), floor_contacts.py + contacts_round.sh (bodies touching the floor, robot vs reference), body_min_z.py

expect.floor contacts in support: only wrists (and feet), no torso / elbow / shoulder (r03: torso 7, elbows 14 / 10 steps)
expect.elbow in support: near the reference (~1.3 rad; r03 down to -0.46)
expect.segment probe start 0: never lost >= 0.6 (r03 0.78; may drop first while the new support is learned)

rollback_if: landed_upright False and start-0 never-lost < 0.3: r05 from r03 model_2998 with margin 0.2 (looser)
